What’s inside

18 Themes Editorial, broadcast, and publication looks, each with a density scale 13 Coloring Fill cells, columns, and rows by value, rank, or condition 7 Annotations Captions, headers, cut lines, watermarks, and margin notes 5 Layout Fold one long table into blocks, or arrange several as small multiples 4 Viewing + Saving Crop, pad, and size a saved table for export or posting 13 Formatting Ordinals, tallies, deltas, significance stars, and scale notes
